title: Xometry Reports Record Second Quarter 2026 Results
excerpt: Marketplace revenue grew 45%, active buyers grew 20% to 89,557 and accounts spending at least USD 50,000 grew 23% to 2,039.
summary: Xometry's filed Q2 release supplies marketplace operating metrics and management's non-GAAP bridge. Marketplace growth accelerated, buyer and larger-account counts increased, and adjusted EBITDA reached USD 14.1 million, while GAAP net loss remained USD 5.3 million and the June financing materially increased liquidity and share count.
